entries.title: A task waiting for Automatic says what it waits for
entries.body: When Automatic holds a new task back, its Details and its line in Activity now say why: a computer short of spare processing capacity or memory, room set aside for other tasks that are starting, or each computer's own reason. Automatic also frees the room it set aside for a task once that task is running and measured. Before, the first new task after a quiet spell could wait for room your computer had.

picture.alt: A queued task's record whose Computer choice row reads Waiting for room set aside for other tasks that are starting.
